status: single-training-seed reference-structure experiment; not final model selection

reconstruction_check.scope: Training-only reconstruction check; independent model discarded.

limitations: One training seed; generation-seed SD does not measure retraining variability.
Pilot uses a deliberately short fixed budget. Validation chooses checkpoints; test remains untouched by model evaluation.
Sigmoid recovery bounds generated features to training ranges, limiting tail extrapolation. This is a model choice, not post-processing.
No price-ladder or spread constraints are built in; no clipping, sorting, filtering or repair is applied.
Allocator peaks include main training, evaluation and reload, exclude the separate sanity check and CUDA context/driver allocations.
Feature-generation timing includes noise creation, batched inference and CPU transfer, but excludes book decoding and metrics.
Checkpoints support generation; exact interrupted-training resume is not implemented.

decoder_heldout_inputs: 20 prices at the window's anchor snapshot
comparison_protocol.ar_initialisation: Uniform bootstrap of training-window histories; last p rows used by VAR(p).
comparison_protocol.timegan_initialisation: Generate feature windows from noise; do not encode validation histories or futures.
comparison_protocol.pairing: Generated sample i is paired with chronological real window i.
comparison_protocol.window_policy: Non-overlapping sequence_length-update windows with at least reference_history_length past within-split features.
comparison_protocol.selection: Lowest seed-mean invalid rate, then mean KL, ACF error, p and ridge; SSIM is reported, not a tie-breaker.
prohibited: held-out feature histories as generator inputs
repairing or dropping invalid generated books
comparison_protocol.scope: Anchored feature generation, not forecasting the particular observed future or generating starting prices.

depth_ssim.images: Separate ask and bid images, each 10 levels x sequence_length updates; levels 1 through 10.
depth_ssim.aggregation: Mean over valid 7x7 windows, then equal mean of sides, sequences and generation seeds.
depth_ssim.clipping: none; negative or above-training-range depths stay in the score and validity checks
depth_ssim.reference_range: Nominal training reference range [0, 1]; fixed even for held-out or generated extremes.
depth_ssim.variant: Wang et al. SSIM equation; 7x7 uniform windows/sample covariance, not the paper's 11x11 Gaussian setting.

review_benchmark.scope: Synthetic fixed batches; two G/E updates and one D opportunity per joint iteration. Short serial timing samples, not a quality comparison or full-run speedup. Default scripted reference cell; no training data used.

budget_experiment.scope: Training-stage budgets and validation checkpoint frequency changed together; one training seed, no test scoring.

ssim_controls.meaning: Identity checks the metric; shuffled real diagnoses pairing sensitivity, not a ceiling or selection criterion.
